sloka: तत् प्रवृत्तं महद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ।अन्तरिक्षे च भूमौ च पुनश्च गिरिमूर्धनि ।। ६.११०.३६ ।।
transliteration: tat pravṛttaṁ mahadyuddhaṁ tumulaṁ romaharṣaṇam ।antarikṣe ca bhūmau ca punaśca girimūrdhani ।। 6.110.36 ।।

translations.english: Valiant enemy of Raghava also seated in the chariot, rained three hundred, sixties, hundreds, and thousands of arrows.
